protocol.scope: Exploratory SHU development comparison; source-person first-day controls then fixed15-person later-day evaluation

transfer.all_neural_conditions: DIRECT, no alignment, no independent teacher, no target negotiation; alpha=0
transfer.source: own condition and seed; all weights and BatchNorm buffers copied, source state immutable
transfer.target: all layers train; fresh Adam, not source optimizer
transfer.common_initial_backbone: same initialization within architecture at source construction only; CE/Walsh trained source states can differ

source_controls.role: descriptive source-only control; all conditions retained, no outcome-dependent selection

seed_rules.global_training_RNG: reset to batch seed after build/source load; Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA
seed_rules.sample_order_generator: separate torch.Generator using batch seed; exact restart state stored

preprocessing.definition: channel mean/(population SD+1e-6), symmetrically clipped by per-channel0.999 linear quantile of abs(training z)
preprocessing.source_scaling: each source own70 within fold/main; never heldout source or target adaptation statistics
preprocessing.compute_dtype: float64 through filtering then float32 network
preprocessing.rationale: preexisting outlier diagnosis and source controls; not chosen by new later-day accuracy

filterbank.implementation: cheb2ord Wn -> cheby2 SOS -> sosfiltfilt pertrial

FBCNet_adaptation.source: Pinned Mane et al. author implementation and MIT license in sources/author
FBCNet_adaptation.constraint_timing: initial fresh model and after each Adam step; eval forward is pure
adaptations: SOS forward/backward bank using returned cheb2ord Wn instead of author default causal lfilter
raw logits for controlled CE/Walsh outputs

EEGNet.core: byte-identical audited preceding pilot; layer/BN state and maxnorm recorded by trainer

CSP.component_order_meaning: three largest and three smallest eigenvalues, alternating

SINGLE_CSP_LDA.feature: MNE log average squared CSP output; per-band six components
SINGLE_CSP_LDA.source_information: Target50 only; unlike transferred networks, no additional source-person training information

filtering.feature: MNE log average squared CSP output (average_power), not an added test normalization
filtering.comparison_scope: Different band/spatial-feature pipeline from CNN; CSP-versus-CNN is not a pure classifier-head contrast.

CSP.component_order_meaning: three largest and three smallest eigenvalues, alternating

BANK_CSP_LDA.feature: MNE log average squared CSP output; per-band six components
BANK_CSP_LDA.source_information: Target50 only; unlike transferred networks, no additional source-person training information

filtering.implementation: cheb2ord Wn -> cheby2 SOS -> sosfiltfilt pertrial

BANK_CSP_LDA.pipeline_scope: Exactly the FBCNet shared9band filterbank; independent6CSP per band, concatenate54, no band/feature selection

protocol.classical_comparison_limit: Classical target-only50 vs neural additionally700 source trials; CSP bank/path changes are not solely a final-head substitution

decision.CE: raw logit argmax (not softmax float32 argmax)
decision.Walsh: original float32 sigmoid then Euclidean Walsh distance
decision.Walsh_posterior: historical1e-7 bit clipping; stable class logsumexp with no class-probability clipping; preserve any native/posterior decision disagreement

temperature.source: reserved target first-day20 only after fit50
temperature.native_decision_invariant: temperature does not improve native accuracy; preserve CE logit/Walsh Euclidean decisions

later_day_gate.later_metadata_and_original_event_labels: No EEG or prediction values inspected before campaign freeze

analysis.unit: 15 target people; each person mean over5 starts, fixed10 source pool
analysis.test: paired two-sided t-tests on person differences, Holm across exactly5 comparisons

interpretation_limits: SHU/Lee were already inspected; exploratory development, not new independent validation
uncertainty conditional on fixed10 source people
20-trial temperature estimation and cross-day shift remain limitations

execution.resume: only exact code/data/protocol/environment and checksum checkpoint containing model/Adam/targets/order/Python-NumPy-Torch-CPU-CUDA RNG; old process confirmed dead first
execution.hourly_reporting: operational counts/aliveness/error every hour in Turkish; no partial science
